semantics: docs/specs/timers.md §4 (the fold), §2.3 (timing). Parse every `at` to integer epoch milliseconds, truncating sub-millisecond digits (never rounding, never through a float or a Date); all arithmetic is integer.

fold(run_id, steps, events, frozen): events are in server arrival order. Pass 1, arrival: skip an id already seen (ids compared lowercase; the first occurrence wins); `finish` gets no effect (the server decides it); with `frozen`, every event at arrival index >= frozen.after is void with frozen.reason and not folded; a `start` is applied if its id is run_id, else void `merged`; the first `stop`/`discard` is the terminal, later ones void `already_closed`; a `stop` before the start is void `before_start`, one more than max_run_ms after it void `too_long`, whenever it arrives (checked before `already_closed`), and neither closes the run.

Pass 2, by (at, lowercase id) ascending, except that a resume with the same at as the pause its pause_id names sorts right after that pause (several such resumes by lowercase id): void `before_start` if at < start; `after_stop` if at > terminal.at; `too_long` if at > start + max_run_ms; next/lap/skip with seg != the open segment's index: `stale`. next closes the open segment and opens the next pending step (a lap when none is left); lap closes it and opens a lap (pending unchanged). skip on a step segment must name that step (else `stale`): it joins `skipped` and the open segment is relabelled to the next pending step (or a lap); skip on a lap: `no_step` if nothing is pending, `stale` unless it names the head of pending, which joins `skipped`. pause: `already_paused` if paused. resume: `not_paused` if not paused, `stale` unless pause_id is the open pause's id; else the pause [paused_since, at) closes.

Terminal stop: an open pause ends at the stop, the open segment closes at it, status `stopped` (the server says `finishing` while required answers are missing). Discard: status `discarded`, no open segment or pause. Otherwise `paused` or `running`.

Segments: pauses stay whole; a segment's paused_ms is its overlap with them (an open pause covers up to the segment's end: measure it to that end, not to a large sentinel), active_ms = length - paused_ms. Lap labels are 'Lap n', n counting lap segments from 1 in segment order (the open one included). open.index = closed segment count; next_step = head of pending while the run is open, else null.
Instants out: UTC, 'Z', six fraction digits only when the millisecond part is not zero (how the API writes them). Compare by parsing to milliseconds or as strings.

timing (stopped runs only): started_at, ended_at, paused_ms = sum of pauses, active_ms = ended - started - paused_ms, complete = the version has no steps, or every one of its steps has a segment and none was skipped; edited = false; and the state's segments, skipped and pauses.
